items.title: Jalen Coker: Practices fully Tuesday
items.text:
Coker (shoulder) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Bound for IR
items.text:
Giants general manager Joe Schoen said Tuesday that Tracy (hamstring) is slated to be placed on injured reserve, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Plans to play through back issue
items.text:
Barkley said after Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys that his "hamstring came out great," and noted that the back issue that kept him out for the entire fourth quarter isn't anything that he expects to prevent him from playing Sunday against the Commanders, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dameon Pierce: Makes late exit in Week 7
items.text:
Pierce didn't take the field for either of the Eagles' final two possessions of Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys after sustaining an undisclosed injury with 8:38 remaining in the fourth quarter, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Trending toward return in Week 8
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) is "believed to be close to 100 percent" and is expected to play Sunday versus the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Sits out walkthrough practice
items.text:
Golden (shoulder/foot) didn't participate in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
